stories.title: 爸爸，我刚眯了一会儿
stories.excerpt: 下午两点左右的钢琴课，车上睡着的洋芋，还有爸爸配合着聊别的小片段。
paragraphs: 洋芋是家里的二宝。他才六岁，我还很难用几个词说清他的性格，只能讲些小故事。
他喜欢搭话，也喜欢复述别人的话。我觉得，他有时是在给自己留一点思考的时间。
钢琴课大约在下午两点。每次我开车送他去上课，他都会在车上睡着。到了地方，无论是他自己醒来，还是我喊醒他，他都会下意识地说，“爸爸，我刚眯了一会儿。”
我觉得，他可能是怕我生气。我了解他，也就配合着打个马虎眼，聊些别的，哄着他去上课。

en.title: Dad, I just had a little nap
en.excerpt: A piano lesson around two, Yang Yu falling asleep in the car, and Dad playing along and talking about something else.
paragraphs: Yang Yu was our second child. He was only six, and I still find it hard to describe his personality in a few words. I can only tell some little stories.
He liked joining in conversations, and he liked repeating what other people said. I felt that sometimes he was giving himself a little time to think.

His piano lessons were around two in the afternoon. Whenever I drove him to class, he would fall asleep in the car. When we arrived, whether he woke up on his own or I woke him, he would instinctively say, “Dad, I just had a little nap.”
I felt he might be worried I would be annoyed. I knew him, so I played along, talked about something else, and coaxed him into class.

stories.title: 洋芋的三个名字
stories.excerpt: 方智灏、洋芋和 George，这三个名字是怎么来的。
paragraphs: 洋芋姓方，名智灏。按家族辈分，他是“政”字辈。
“智灏”这个名字，是师傅根据他的生辰八字取的。当时师傅说，他的八字很好，以后会很优秀，也说名字里补上了八字所缺的火。
我们叫他洋芋，是因为哥哥叫洋葱。用蔬菜给兄弟俩起小名，挺好玩的，也取了妈妈姓氏的谐音。
给他取英文名的时候，哥哥正好在看《小猪佩奇》。佩奇有个弟弟，叫乔治。正好洋芋也属猪，那就干脆叫 George 吧。

en.title: The story behind his three names
en.excerpt: How he came to be called Fang Zhihao, Yang Yu, and George.
paragraphs: His full Chinese name was 方智灏, Fang Zhihao. Fang was his family name, and Zhihao his given name. In our family’s naming tradition, he belonged to the generation associated with the character 政, pronounced Zheng.

Zhihao was chosen by a traditional naming practitioner using his bazi, a Chinese birth chart. At the time, the practitioner said his bazi was very good and that he would grow up to be outstanding. He also said the name made up for the fire element missing from the chart.

We called him Yang Yu because his big brother was called Yang Cong. Yang Cong means onion, and Yang Yu means potato. Giving the brothers vegetable nicknames was fun, and the nicknames also echoed their mum’s surname.

When we were choosing an English name for him, his big brother happened to be watching Peppa Pig. Peppa has a little brother called George. Yang Yu was born in the Year of the Pig, too, so we thought we might as well call him George.

stories.title: 当小标兵的这一天
stories.excerpt: 白天，洋芋在幼儿园当小标兵。晚上，他坐在椅子上读书，笑得很开心。
paragraphs: 2025年10月13日，洋芋在幼儿园当小标兵。
幼儿园每天会有两位小朋友值日，负责给入园的小朋友测量体温，帮大家洗手、消毒。
照片里，洋芋穿着红色的衣服，戴着蓝色绶带，拿着体温计给一位小朋友测体温。
洋芋从小班入园，如今已经读到大班，快要毕业了。看着他当小标兵的这些照片，我觉得他很自信。
到了晚上，洋芋坐在椅子上，手里摊着书，笑得很开心。

en.title: A day as a kindergarten helper
en.excerpt: Yang Yu was on duty as a kindergarten helper that day. That evening, he sat in a chair with a book, smiling happily.
paragraphs: On 13 October 2025, Yang Yu was on duty as a helper at kindergarten.
Two children take on this role each day. They check the temperatures of children arriving at kindergarten and help them wash and sanitise their hands.
In the photos, Yang Yu is wearing red clothes and a blue sash, holding a thermometer to check another child’s temperature.
Yang Yu started in the youngest class. Now he is in the oldest class and will soon be finishing kindergarten. Looking at these photos of him on duty, I think he looks very confident.
That evening, Yang Yu sat in a chair with a book open in his hands, smiling happily.

stories.title: 仰头看看妈妈的手机
stories.excerpt: 上学前的电梯里，洋芋背着书包，仰起头去看妈妈的手机。
paragraphs: 2025年10月14日早上，妈妈送洋芋去上学，在电梯里拍下了这段小视频。
洋芋穿着红色外套，背着书包，站在妈妈身旁。妈妈举着手机对着镜子拍，他往妈妈身边凑了凑，探过身子，仰起头去看手机。
看他伸长脖子的样子，真可爱。
stories.sourceLabel: 根据爸爸的讲述与提供的视频画面整理

en.title: Looking up at Mum’s phone
en.excerpt: In the lift on the way to school, Yang Yu had his schoolbag on his back and tilted his head up to look at Mum’s phone.
paragraphs: On the morning of 14 October 2025, Mum was taking Yang Yu to school and filmed this short clip in the lift.

Yang Yu was wearing a red jacket and had his schoolbag on his back, standing beside Mum. As Mum held up her phone to film them in the mirror, he moved a little closer, leaned over and tilted his head up to look at the phone.
He looks so sweet with his neck stretched up like that.
en.sourceLabel: Edited from Dad’s account and the supplied video images
